result.topic_en: Riemann expresses the Euler-type integral $\int_a^b (z-a)^\alpha(z-b)^\beta(z-c)^\gamma(z-d)^\delta dz$, multiplied by suitable powers of the differences of a,b,c,d, as a P-function of the cross-ratio x, relates the exponents $\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta$ to $\lambda,\mu,\nu$, and assigns sign-changed P-functions to different integration paths.
